notes.title: Fourtex Jugo full release!
notes.content:
Today is launch day. Five new levels added along with polish. That is a total of 40 handcrafted, brain-teasing puzzles plus 3 random dailies. 

Jugo is one of the more challenging puzzle games around. Do you fancy a challenge? If so, give Jugo a try.

notes.title: Fourtex Jugo launches April 13th!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/apps/499560/008166ecea0250a3ca716a971751fe0c83bcd350.jpg[/img]

We are truly excited to announce that Fourtex Jugo will be leaving Early Access, and launching fully and in its complete form on April 13th!

Fourtex Jugo is unlike any puzzle game you've played before:

- Various play modes allow self-selection of difficulty on a particular level. On each level, you can shoot for 1, 2 or 3 stars, each getting increasingly more difficult, or you can just shoot for the high score.

- The AI is, along with every other aspect of play, 100% deterministic. So, you can plan accordingly, but plan you must, or risk your pie getting eaten.

- The rules are simple combine the particles to achieve the highest score possible. But, doing so while avoiding the claws will be a satisfying challenge.

Lorin has put together a pair of developer Let's Play videos for players to reference ahead of next week's release as well:

[url]https://youtu.be/20lQ2N0YJE4[/url]

[url]https://youtu.be/Jm6t2SbMBKI[/url]

While Fourtex Jugo will be essentially complete after next week's launch, this will be far from the end. The game will keep on getting better and richer for as long as possible. There are many new ideas, and puzzles that we hope to bring about in later updates.

Look out for more info over the coming weeks -- thank you so much for your support and feedback during early access!

notes.title: First major update "Cloverleaf" (v 0.9.30)
notes.content:
[h1]What's new[/h1]

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Five new levels
[*] New play screen layout with board centered
[*] Faster particle pickup after a combination has been made
[*] Added a replay button to the play screen (hotkey "F", controller "X")
[*] Target score indicator turns player score blue when enough bonus particles to reach target are in play
[*] Added a basic on-screen quick reference guide (hotkey "V", controller is mapped to "RT"). This guide will be improved to include all basic aspects of game play
[*] Perfect (3-star) game highest score stays on leaderboard even after getting a higher 2-star score (use the toggle button with 3 stars in leaderboard menu to switch between highest scores and just highest 3-star scores) Note: this starts now, so unfortunately any existing 3-star scores will still be overwritten by higher 2-star scores
[*] Tips and invalid move messages are simpler and use more graphics and less text
[/list]

[b]Tweaks and Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Minor UI tweaks and bug fixes
[*] The highest value particles are now called "Noms" as in "Nominal Particles"
[*] Always return to the Leaderboard menu after a playing a recorded leaderboad game
[*] Play screen hotkey for level select is "R", the controller is mapped to "LT"
[*] Changed the look of high value particles by using abstract symbols instead of text
[*] Fixed bug in Jugo Master achievement, all achievements should now pop correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Play Jugo at SIEGE October 7-9, 2016
notes.content:
Salty Dog Digital (that's us!) are going to SIEGE. It's in Atlanta, GA (USA), from Oct. 7 – 9. We'll have some space in the Indie Cluster. We're really excited at the prospect of meeting folks and getting helpful feedback on our game Jugo (which is coming soon!). We hope you can come and see us there. More info at [url=https://siegecon.net/]https://siegecon.net/[/url]

We're also attending Steam Dev Days in Seattle, WA (USA). That's Oct. 12-13.  We're hoping this will also help make our Early Access release as good as it can be. More info at [url=http://steamcommunity.com/devdays/]http://steamcommunity.com/devdays/[/url]
